top_signals.title: SpaceX Crew Capsule Splashes Down in Pacific After ISS Stay
top_signals.summary:
A SpaceX capsule carrying four astronauts returned from space and splashed down off the coast of California, capping the crew’s mission to the International Space Station.
The crew, part of a mission called Crew-12, had been living and working on the ISS since February, after launching to space in the same SpaceX Dragon spacecraft that brought them home. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Longshots Losing 98% of Time Dominate Kalshi, Polymarket Trading
top_signals.summary: Bettors on Polymarket and Kalshi often make longshot wagers, with around half of all trading volume on Kalshi involving potential returns of at least 1,000%. These longshot bets have resulted in significant losses for bettors, with money staked on "yes" longshots losing 15% on Kalshi and 27% on Polymarket since early 2025.Bloomberg's Denitsa Tsekova joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
